Write a model as rxode2 text

Source: R/rxode2.R
sbml_to_rxode2.Rd

Prints the derived equations (sbml_odes()) in the model syntax of the rxode2 package: constants and assignments as x = ...;, initial conditions as x(0) = ...; and right-hand sides as d/dt(x) = ...;. The text is self-contained; edit the constants or pass parameters to override them.

Usage

sbml_to_rxode2(m, events = c("refuse", "drop"))

Arguments

m

An sbml_model.

events

"refuse" (the default) raises zusbml_unsupported for a model with events; "drop" leaves them out.

Value

A single string of rxode2 model code.

Details

rxode2 text cannot express SBML events, which change states at triggered times, so a model with events is refused unless events = "drop", which writes the continuous part only (design D10). Names rxode2 cannot take, ids starting with _ and those it reserves such as time or param, are written with a .u prefix: _J0 becomes .u_J0.

Examples

m <- sbml_read(system.file("extdata", "decay.xml", package = "zusbml"))
cat(sbml_to_rxode2(m))
#> # decay, written by zusbml from SBML Level 3 Version 2
#> C = 1;
#> k1 = 1;
#> S1(0) = 1;
#> S2(0) = 0;
#> R1 = C * k1 * S1;
#> d/dt(S1) = -R1/C;
#> d/dt(S2) = R1/C;
